$comment: Pre-authorization policy for unattended SDLC runs. Copy this file to a consuming repo as .claude/autonomy.json to override. Every gated action defaults to NOT pre-authorized: the run continues and records the request instead of halting. Flipping one to true is a standing human authorization for that class of action in this repo.

decide.$comment: Gates whose output is a document. Safe to decide and record with reasoning.

act.$comment: Gates with irreversible external effect. Default off. Turning one on is a real authorization.

escalation.$comment: Where a blocked gate is reported at end of run. 'return' puts it in the workflow return value only.
